_doc: mA bands of the three ParticleNet networks (user decision 2026-11-28): as SignalRegionStudy python/interpolation_config.py NORM_MA_BINS; a grid mA belongs to the band with lo <= mA < hi (the last band also includes hi). Each band network is trained on the signal points of its band (configs/windows.json) and scores every grid mA of its band. Background training entries: once per band whose mass range (union of the band's template windows, template pairing, per channel) contains the event; mA drawn per event (python/bands.py).
